cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:
cs.content: The structure of vascular plants from the level of single cell to the level of whole organism will be presented. Anatomical descriptions and physiological functions of plant organelles, cells, tissues and organs will be described with focus on important species for agricultural use. The skills in plant objects preparation for microscopic observation, light microscopy will be attained in the practical training.
